newsitem.title: ITALY: Ethiopian flies winter produce to Italian markets.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopian flies winter produce to Italian markets.

text.p: Ethiopian Airlines is using its Boeing 757-PF freighter to ship some 35 tonnes of fresh produce on each of its twice-weekly Addis Ababa to Italy's Forli airport flights, airline sources said.

The vegetables and fruit carried are grown in Ethiopia by Italian farmers from the Romagna region of Italy. 90 percent of the winter season shipment comprises green beans with the remainder made up by strawberries and asparagus, they added.
Ethiopian also operates a weekly year-round all-cargo flight from of Rome's Fiumicino to Addis Ababa using the 757 freighter. Alitalia has rights to two pallets on this flight.

Last year Ethiopian carried 440 tonnes ex-Italy on this service, while Alitalia moved 89 tonnes. A further 269 tonnes of air cargo was carried as bellyhold to Addis Ababa on the airline's passenger Boeing 757 and 767s, the sources added.
Italy ranks fifth in importance as a cargo station for Ethiopian, behind Dubai, Bombay, Addis Ababa and Frankfurt.
